title: Qwen3-8B FP8 on vLLM: single 24GB card
slug_note: Official FP8 export (9.4GB) leaves a large KV pool on one 24GB card.

variation.revision_note: HF snapshot of Qwen/Qwen3-8B-FP8 resolved and served on the Spark during the 2026-10-25 test

engine.config: Stock vLLM serve at 32K; add --rope-scaling yarn factor 4.0 for 128K

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-10-25): 113.8 GiB dropped from MemAvailable with the recipe as written (vLLM default --gpu-memory-utilization (0.9), so this is the reservation, not the model's minimum need). That is vLLM's 0.9 reservation of the shared pool, not the model's minimum need. Earlier estimate: 9.4GB weights + activations + KV for a 32K context; 128K YaRN raises KV demand.

drop in MemAvailable from before start (OS file cache dropped) to server ready; vLLM default --gpu-memory-utilization (0.9), so this is the reservation, not the model's minimum need

caveats: Checkpoint size computed from the HF API.

Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-25), in vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0 with the HF cache mounted: server ready 260 s after `docker run` (weights from local disk, kernel autotune included); the functional check passed. 113.8 GiB dropped from MemAvailable is vLLM's default 0.9 reservation of the 128 GB pool, not the model's minimum need.
